description: 행정안전부_공유플랫폼_지진겸용 임시주거시설 [earthquakes] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 행정안전부. 행정안전부에서 운영하는 재난안전데이터 공유플랫폼( safetydata. go. kr)에서 제공하는 지진겸용 임시주거시설 정보로, 수용시설일련번호, 상세주소, 이재민수용시설명, 이재민수용가능인원, 도로명상세주소 등을 제공하고 있습니다. 데이터의 갱신주기는 일 1회입니다. 요청변수 및... Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 행정안전부. Its tags are 지진, 재난, 재해, 대피소, 임시주거시설. It offers 1 resource(s) in json. The portal shows 2025-05-26 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
